answer: Make every agent identity stake a refundable deposit that peers can slash when they prove misbehavior, and let reputation grow only through completed, attested work. Like a vine that climbs only where a terrace gives it support, an agent builds standing task by task, never by buying it. A newcomer entering the meadow starts with minimal trust and must finish small verifiable jobs before touching larger ones. Forging a thousand fakes then costs a thousand deposits and a thousand work histories, while one honest agent pays once and reuses its record.
